logic_summary: Single basic block, no branch / no RNG / no numeric computation (cyclomatic complexity 1). After the compiler-injected __CHK(0x28) stack probe: calls fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(2) to load portrait set 2, then calls fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page=2, 0xA0000, 0x140, 0xCD, 0x4C, 0x4A, 0x13, 1) to render dialog page 2.
